scope_note: Names beginning self. are per-player. Each client's state store holds its own player's values under these names; the host keeps every seat's copy, companions' included. Names beginning run. are shared and replicated by the host. The resolver runs once per client, on that client's store (DESIGN.md section 13).

state.name: run.humans
state.description: Human players at the start, 1-4.

state.name: run.companions
state.description: Companion brothers filling empty seats (4 minus humans).

state.name: self.seat
state.description: Per player: raft seat (a bow-left, b bow-right, c stern-left, d stern-right).

state.name: self.temperament
state.description: Per player: temperament chosen at the mark stone.

state.name: self.mark
state.description: Per player: the sign chosen at the mark stone.

state.name: self.counter_carved
state.description: Per player: carved his counter piece in s1_carve_counter.

state.name: run.counters_moves
state.description: Every Bone Counters turn.

state.name: self.sow_on_beat
state.description: Per player: share of on-beat drops across both counters sittings; >=70 +15 ms river window, <=40 -10 ms.

state.name: self.kept_counter
state.description: Per player: pocketed his counter piece when the lights dimmed.

state.name: run.gifts
state.description: Every gift carved.

state.name: self.gift_given
state.description: Per player: form of the tool he carved.

state.name: self.gift_received
state.description: Per player: form of the tool carved for him.

state.name: self.gift_quality
state.description: Per player: quality of the gift he holds (true >=80%, rough 60-79%, keepsake <60%).

state.name: self.gift_marked
state.description: Per player: the gift he holds carries his mark; +20 ms grip window at the heart.

state.name: run.song
state.description: The Marrow-Song as arranged.

state.name: run.song_harmony
state.description: Song harmony; >=75 +15 ms river window for all, <=40 -10 ms.

state.name: run.song_complete
state.description: Verse one sung; starts the 2-minute count to the Recognition.

state.name: run.song_last_beat
state.description: Beat of the heart verse's last note, counted from the start of singing in the heart.

state.name: self.refused
state.description: Per player: sat on the elders' bench at the Recognition and stayed.

state.name: run.stayers
state.description: Players who stayed.

state.name: run.climb_lifts
state.description: Lifts completed on the climb; run.sync starts at 50 + 3 x lifts, max 70.

state.name: run.stayer_beat
state.description: The stayer's pulse-wall timing; up to +15 ms on the raft's window, fading by chapter (full c5, 60% c6, 30% c7, none c8). The wall carries the beat only, never voices.

state.name: run.sync
state.description: Group timing on the river; >=70 speed x1.25, <=30 yaw and splashes.

state.name: self.in_time
state.description: Per player: share of rowing beats stroked on the beat, river and delta.

state.name: run.notice
state.description: Immune beasts' notice during patrols; at 100 one brother is taken.

state.name: self.exposure
state.description: Per player: his share of notice; the highest is taken.

state.name: run.taken_count
state.description: Brothers taken by an immune beast; capped at 1. At 1 no hands can lock at the heart (a cost to the whole raft).

state.name: run.taken_seat
state.description: Seat of the taken brother.

state.name: self.taken
state.description: Per player: he was taken into the hold. Decides Taken by the River for him alone.

state.name: self.scout_pings
state.description: Per player: hazards pinged from the hold by a taken brother.

state.name: run.route
state.description: Branch Chart choices.

state.name: run.calm_count
state.description: Calm pools reached; one in the delta gives the heart verse 2 minutes.

state.name: self.next_counter_carved
state.description: Per player (stayer): finished the counter for the next group's child.

state.name: self.taught_pulse
state.description: Per player (stayer): kept time with the child for 16 drops in a row.

state.name: self.grip
state.description: Per player: grip at the heart; drains each beat, re-squeezed on the beat.

state.name: self.held_together
state.description: Per player: his hand locked with another's on the song's last note.

state.name: self.swept_order
state.description: Per player: order of separation at the heart (1 = first).

state.name: run.separations
state.description: Each separation at the heart, in order, shared so the stayer's wall can skip a beat for each and every client can cut that brother's voice.

state.name: run.dropins
state.description: Companion drop-ins for disconnected players.
